title: benchmark_source
description: Identifies which upstream benchmark a case comes from and its provenance.

upstream_commit.description: Full git commit SHA of the upstream repo at freeze time.

category.description: Task category within the benchmark (e.g. GEN category or repurpose family).

case_id.description: Official case/task identifier from the upstream benchmark.

task_semantics_modified.description: Must be false — official instruction must not be rewritten.

agent.description: Agent framework used (always OpenClaw in this project).
